business_problem: Bestv TV needed to deliver smooth ultra-HD live broadcasts for sports events and exclusive performances even when network conditions fluctuated and very large audiences surged into streams at once. It also wanted to improve perceived picture quality for motion-heavy scenes and celebrity close-ups without forcing every broadcast to run at the highest possible bitrate.
solution_summary: Bestv TV used Alibaba Cloud Video Live as the base for an AI-enhanced live-streaming workflow tuned for sports and performance events. Incoming live video is processed through Narrowband HD 2.0, which applies adaptive encoding to reduce bitrate and then uses generative detail restoration to recover visual clarity lost under constrained transmission conditions. For distribution and resilience, MediaUni supplies a globally scaled delivery fabric with thousands of nodes and large bandwidth reserves, plus disaster-recovery plans and automatic primary/backup stream switching when interruptions or frame-rate anomalies occur. Bestv also deploys custom transcoding templates and AI restoration models, using portrait-oriented settings for concerts and detail enhancement for basketball so faces, jersey numbers, floor textures, and court lines remain clearer. The design combines bandwidth efficiency, AI-based image restoration, and high-concurrency delivery in one production live-video pipeline.

solution_components.name: Video Live
solution_components.role: Provides the production live-streaming platform used to ingest, process, and deliver Bestv's event broadcasts.

solution_components.name: Narrowband HD 2.0
solution_components.role: Applies adaptive encoding and generative detail restoration so lower-bitrate streams still retain strong visual quality.

solution_components.name: MediaUni
solution_components.role: Supplies globally distributed delivery capacity, traffic preparation, and failover for large live events.

solution_components.name: AI restoration models
solution_components.role: Enhance event-specific video details such as faces, jersey numbers, textures, and boundary lines during transcoding.

data_flow: Live event streams enter Alibaba Cloud Video Live, where Narrowband HD 2.0 and custom AI restoration models transcode and enhance the video before MediaUni distributes it through the global delivery network. During peak events, reserved bandwidth and primary/backup streams keep the signal available while viewers receive clearer images at lower bitrates.
business_outcome: Bestv TV improved the visual experience of high-concurrency event streaming while keeping transmission stable under difficult network conditions. Alibaba Cloud's live-video stack let the platform combine lower-bitrate delivery with clearer images, stronger burst handling, and better resilience for major sports and entertainment broadcasts.
architecture_clues: Generative detail restoration is applied after adaptive encoding so bandwidth can drop without giving up perceived clarity.
Primary and backup streams switch automatically when interruptions or frame-rate anomalies occur.
Bestv uses different transcoding templates and AI models for concerts and basketball broadcasts because the visual requirements differ by event type.
